```python
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = case["required_symbols"]
    # Build index and children
    node_map = {}
    children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        node_map[nid] = node
        children[nid] = []
    for node in nodes:
        parent = node.get("parent")
        if parent is not None:
            children[parent].append(node["id"])
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    removed_order = []
    # Sort nodes by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        if nid == "root":
            continue
        if node["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        if not node.get("removable", False):
            continue
        # Check has retained children
        if any(cid in retained for cid in children.get(nid, [])):
            continue
        # Remove
        retained.discard(nid)
        removed_order.append(nid)
    retained_ids = sorted(retained)
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_ids
    }
```
